description: Show or hide the mold report for the active part. This is the same report as mold_dfm, including part mass, the published tooling estimate, part price, and assumptions (rates, sources, as-of dates, and formulas). on true measures the mesh and returns volume, projected area, side-action count, and those estimates for grade, quantity, and cavityCount. Part price is material cost plus press time plus tooling divided by quantity. cavityCount stays in the costing call and does not scale the published rate card. It is not a control in the pane. A missing density, price, area, or wall is flagged and not guessed. A priced catalog, when one is passed in, still prices from that catalog. on false closes the panel. Omit on to toggle. It does not paint a skin and it does not place an order. Read-only. Molding rules: guide { topic: "molding" }. Long runs: an analysis still going after about 30 s answers { status: "running", stillRunning: true, jobId, command, phase?, percent?, elapsedSec, etaSec? } instead of the result. That is a heartbeat, not the result. Call mold_status { job_id } (it waits up to about 30 s each time) until it answers the result; the analysis keeps running in the tab and is not restarted.

cavityCount.description: Cavities in the mold, from 1 to 64. Omit to keep the current count. Not a cavity layout.

grade.description: Resin grade. Omit to keep the current grade, or the partner’s cheapest active grade when none is set.

on.description: true shows the mold report. false closes it. Omit to toggle.

quantity.description: Parts to amortize tooling over. Omit to keep the current quantity.
